{{Top|leg}}
'''Hoshen''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Hoshen commented on the entry for the [[Arelik Armor]], noting how easy the armor was to modify.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
